messages:
eric: rolling the batch-inference v2.4.1 canary to 20% now. noticing error rate jump on /generate from 0.3% -> 6% on canary.
incident-bot: Pager alert: INF-DEPLOY-ERR spike on canary group 'batch-2026' (deploy id deploy-2026-03-15-01). 15:23 UTC. Severity: P1. Links: <https://console.redwood/deploys/deploy-2026-03-15-01>
mira: oncall here, joining. can you post deploy id + affected models?
eric: deploy id deploy-2026-03-15-01, model batchbert-3b-quant. Canary target 20% traffic across dedicated pool 'dedicated-us-east-1-b'.
sam: I see tokenization errors in logs: 'InvalidToken: seq len mismatch' repeated. looks like model artifact mismatch with tokenizer pack.
alex: confirmed span: errors started at 15:22UTC right after canary cutover. Customer impact: writes to queued inference up to 2s latency but erroring ~6% of requests. Not yet widespread.
mira: we should flip the rollout back to 0% and failover to previous version. who can run rollback now? @alex @sam
alex: I can run rollback. preparing commands.
deploy-bot: Deployment rollback command queued: rollback --id=deploy-2026-03-15-01 --target=0% --force. ETA ~40s. exec by alex.
alex: running now:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --id deploy-2026-03-15-01 --scope canary --to 0%
redwoodctl route set --name batch-2026 --weight 0 --version v2.4.0
```

monitoring: tailing logs & SLO dash.
julie: I'll kick off smoke tests once traffic drains. test plan: 10 requests per model, check error==0 and latency < 800ms.
sam: also please snapshot the canary pods for forensic: `kubectl get pods -l deploy=deploy-2026-03-15-01 -o wide` and `kubectl logs <pod>`
alex: rollback complete on canary pool. routing now at 0%. deploy-bot reports rollback success. link: <https://console.redwood/deploys/deploy-2026-03-15-01>
deploy-bot: rollback finished: deploy-2026-03-15-01 -> canary traffic 0%. Diff applied: route batch-2026 reverted to v2.4.0.
mira: confirming metrics — error rate back down to 0.4% across production; canary errors dropped. Julie please run smoke.
julie: smoke results: 10/10 OK for v2.4.0, latency median 210ms. no errors. Tagging for customer impact assessment.
alex: preserving canary logs/artifacts at s3://redwood-incidents/1939876543/ for postmortem. Sam you want the tokenizer artifacts?
sam: yes please. pull model artifact checksums and tokenizer versions: `sha256sum model.bin tokenizer.json` and save.
eric: summary: rollback executed, immediate customer impact mitigated. Next steps: postmortem owner = sam, RCA to include how model+tokenizer mismatch passed staging. Pager will be closed if we see stable metrics for 30m.
mira: creating incident ticket and assigning. ETA for postmortem draft 48 hours. I'll update with SLA impact calc. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Pager closed by mira. Incident 2026-03-15-1939876543 resolved. Duration 12m. Follow-up tasks created: #ticket-4521.
julie: small note — during rollback we saw one stuck connection in dedicated pool, restarted by oncall script. Flagging for infra: `dedicated-us-east-1-b` health check flaps.
alex: ack. I'll open infra issue. any customer-facing comms needed? product/pm?
mira: product knows; sending short note to customers in impacted orgs. assign comms to @julie for sending templated note.
sam: grabbing artifacts now, will start RCA. Thanks team.
eric: nice work. I'll hand off to oncall until postmortem. everyone sign off when free. :thumbsup:
